# BSIM-SOI 4.7.0

**BSIM-SOI (Silicon-On-Insulator) Model Version 4.7.0**

Released: May 19, 2025

## Description

BSIM-SOI is a compact model designed for Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) MOSFETs. It provides comprehensive modeling capabilities for SOI devices including floating body effects, self-heating, and other SOI-specific phenomena.

## Files

- `bsimsoi.va` - Main Verilog-A model file (388KB)

## Documentation

- `BSIM-SOI_4.7.0_technical_manual.pdf` - Complete technical manual
- `BSIM-SOI_4.7.0_Updates.pdf` - Release notes and updates

## Source

Downloaded from: https://www.bsim.berkeley.edu/models/bsimsoi/

## Usage

Include the main model file `bsimsoi.va` in your SPICE simulator. The model supports SOI MOSFETs and is compatible with most commercial SPICE simulators.

For detailed usage instructions, refer to the technical manual.

## Features

BSIM-SOI 4.7.0 includes modeling capabilities for:
- SOI MOSFET devices
- Floating body effects
- Self-heating effects
- Advanced SOI-specific phenomena

## Note

This is the latest version of BSIM-SOI as of May 2025.
